exposure: Enhanced recovery programme (ERP) after caesarean delivery
Enhanced recovery programmes (ERP) after caesarean delivery
outcome: Maternal feelings toward the relationship with their infant
Comfort in caring for their newborn
cohort: 86 patients after elective or emergency caesarean delivery who had given birth to full-term healthy singleton newborns
finding: The application of an ERP after caesarean delivery was associated with improved maternal satisfaction and more positive feelings toward the relationship with the newborn compared to traditional postoperative care.
